player_prompt.intro:
Nge ujile Mubandi {player_id} ({piece}). Oponente ujile ({opp}). Pesa movimentos como '[b1 c3]' (kutoka → kuenda). Mabandi yote kuyenda kama kavaleiros ya xadrez.
Kila kupata kuscore {score_per_capture} ponto. Jogo kuima pambuka {max_moves} movimentos ou kuwa mubandi ujina movimento legal / ujina mabandi. Ponto ya juu kuwina.

invalid_move.unknown_square: O kididi kiki, ki a k'ixana.
invalid_move.not_your_piece: O ku tokuesa o milongi, ki kua tokala phala eie.
invalid_move.own_piece: O muthu ka tena ku bhanga kima sé kikuatekesu kia athu.
invalid_move.not_knight: Ki ukexilu uambote ua ku bhanga o ima.

game_action.moved: Mukaji {player_id} kuluta kipande kwao kuva {frm} kufika {to}.

outcome.no_pieces: O jokala {player_id} ka tena dingi ku ta o kidimbu kiê.
outcome.higher_score: O ku kuata o kiama kua beta-o-kota.
outcome.move_limit: O nguzu i tu bhanga mu kuenda, ia bhu kiá.
